findings.finding: Noa remains nonverbal; Mina remains practical and guarded; Oldo's incomplete records are not treated as absolute truth.
MOTIF_STAR progresses from a clear three-note upward motif in Episode 1 to an incomplete form in Episode 2 and an ambiguous low signal in Episode 3.
The Star Eater, the sky-call speaker, and the uplink source remain unidentified; testimony and damaged records remain uncertain.

Episode 1's short-film screenplay fixes the Lumina outcome as restoring a streetlight, while the draft game graph offers three alternative choices before Episode 2. The project must explicitly distinguish the fixed short-film cut from the interactive adaptation so they are not treated as simultaneous canon events.
findings.resolution: Approve an adaptation-boundary note in the series bible/project manifest before canon adoption.

findings.finding: Episode 2 refers to one remaining output, but the project does not yet define a machine-readable Lumina charge/resource ledger across episodes. The screenplay is plausible, but gameplay must not infer unlimited re-use.
findings.resolution: Define charge accounting and transition rules in the game state schema before gameplay release.

findings.finding: Episode 2 and Episode 3 use distinct choice IDs, preserve append-only choice history, and describe non-destructive state updates.
